games.title: Focus Lab 20/20
games.description: Live eye-exam game where ALL teams play at once across 3 optical modes: Blurry Vision (sharpen focus), Better 1 or Better 2? (simultaneous vote), and Snellen Eye Chart.
games.offlineReason: All visuals, prompts, timers and sound cues run locally in the browser.
games.instructions: Count off #1-#N per team. Mode 1 (Blurry Vision): click lens sharper (Space) while teams race to buzz in and speak. Mode 2 (Better 1 or 2?): all teams vote simultaneously with 1 or 2 fingers, then Speaker #X explains the error for a +150 bonus. Mode 3 (Snellen Chart): reveal shrinking lines and complete the optician dialogue aloud.
games.requirements: One teacher laptop/projector. No student devices or internet required.

games.title: Bank Vault Auction & Relay
games.description: At the bank: teams bid on vault locks and rotate through every numbered speaker to unlock a +$1,000 full-crew jackpot.
games.offlineReason: Static browser game with local bank prompts, 3-minute vocab flash and local storage.
games.instructions: Each student owns one vault lock (#1–#N). Bid on a vault, coach Speaker #X during the huddle, and let Speaker #X deliver the bank request aloud. Unlocking all crew locks awards a +$1,000 jackpot.
games.requirements: One teacher screen/projector. Keyboard shortcuts: Space (timer), R (reveal), 1/2/3 (verdict).

games.title: Express Parcel Relay
games.description: At the post office: teams race delivery trucks down a visual track by rotating every numbered driver to speak shipping requests aloud.
games.offlineReason: All track graphics, shipping prompts and vocab flash cards run locally.
games.instructions: Count off Drivers #1–#N per team. Driver #X takes the mic after a quick team huddle: Clean Solo moves +2 miles, Assisted Echo moves +1 mile, and a full crew rotation earns a +2 mile lap bonus.
games.requirements: One teacher screen/projector. No student phones required.

games.title: Grand English Showdown
games.description: Semester finale championship: spin the real-life scenario wheel across restaurant, shopping, health, optician, bank and post office units with mandatory speaker rotation.
games.offlineReason: Complete scenario wheel, prompts and scoreboard run locally with zero external dependencies.
games.instructions: Spin the scenario wheel, choose a stake (100/250/500), coach Speaker #X during the huddle, and judge the spoken response. Works in 15, 30 or 45 minutes with Finish & Trophy available at any time.
games.requirements: One teacher screen/projector. No student devices required.

games.title: Concurso de la óptica
games.description: Lead four speaking games from your phone, including 24 yes-or-no traps per level. Practice glasses, eye exams, buffets and Have you ever…?
games.offlineReason: The private teacher panel opens online.
games.instructions: Open the teacher panel and choose a CEFR level and game. Read one card per turn and tap to see a model answer.
games.requirements: One teacher phone with the private access link. Students play verbally.

games.title: Detective Case Files
games.description: Read the case files, connect the evidence, and defend your accusation.
games.offlineReason: All case stories, clues and question files are included in the download.
games.instructions: Choose a mystery, read the case and collect sentences as evidence. Answer five questions, then submit your accusation. Review the official solution and write an investigator’s report. Hints cost points. Mapped answers 1–4 apply to the first unanswered question; Confirm submits when all five are answered.
games.requirements: One screen. Stories contain fictional murder mysteries. Your evidence, scores and report drafts are stored in this browser. Works offline after download.

games.title: Bio Master
games.description: Explore biology through visual quizzes and team challenges.
games.offlineReason: The complete quiz and its question bank are included in the download.

games.title: Classroom Feud
games.description: Guess the most popular answers in a classroom survey showdown.
games.offlineReason: The teacher and projector tabs run offline after download.
games.instructions: Enter optional nicknames and choose a theme or imported survey. Keep the host tab open and move the projector tab to the classroom display. Reveal answers to give the speaking team points, or record a strike to pass the turn. Use mapped buttons 1–8 to reveal and Buzz to strike.
games.requirements: Two tabs in the same browser. Use the teacher buttons, keyboard, touch or mapped controller.

games.title: The Compliance Cipher
games.description: Work through an escape-room mission using English clues.
games.offlineReason: Solo and same-browser classroom rooms work offline. Separate devices need internet.
games.instructions: Solve each clue and submit its access key. Hints add 1 minute and then 5 minutes per stage. Play solo with saved progress, or host a room to follow each team’s progress. Use your own word/clue pack for another topic. Confirm submits and Hint requests a clue.
games.requirements: One screen for solo play. Classroom mode supports multiple teams in tabs of one browser offline, or separate devices through public PeerJS signalling with internet. Keep the host open.

games.title: Escape Planet Earth
games.description: Read sustainability challenges, collect letters and solve five word locks to escape Earth.
games.offlineReason: Same-browser team rooms work offline after download. Separate devices need internet.
games.instructions: Open a teacher room and share its team link. Start when teams are ready. Choose answers to collect letters, solve each five-letter door code and collect the final escape letters. Hints add time to the score.
games.requirements: Use separate tabs in the same browser after downloading. Separate devices connect through PeerJS and need internet. Keep the teacher tab open.

games.title: Flags & Nationalities
games.description: Discover countries, flags, and nationalities in a visual quiz.
games.offlineReason: Country data and every flag image are included in the download.
games.instructions: Show each flag and ask learners to say the country or nationality. Wait for the 15-second timer, then reveal the answer and move to the next question. There are 20 questions per round.
games.requirements: One screen. Learners answer aloud. Confirm reveals the answer after the timer and Next advances after the reveal. Works offline after download.

games.title: Geo Master
games.description: Explore geography while practising English vocabulary.
games.offlineReason: The complete quiz and its question bank are included in the download.

games.title: Grammar Adventurers
games.description: Explore seven illustrated grammar chapters and a final challenge.
games.offlineReason: Chapters, The Vault and the mock test run offline after download.
games.instructions: Open the table of contents and choose a chapter, The Vault, or the final mock test. A quiz pack replaces the mock-test questions. Save a score locally if you want a record.
games.requirements: Keyboard, touch, or mapped controls for chapter turns and numbered quiz choices.

games.title: Grammar Auction
games.description: Wager classroom points on sentence judgments, then spell the leading balance in English to win.
games.offlineReason: Same-browser team rooms work offline after download. Separate devices need internet.
games.instructions: Open a teacher room and share the team link. Join with at least two team screens. Decide if each sentence is correct and wager points. After the rounds, the leading team spells its balance in English to win. The teacher can load a custom sentence pack.
games.requirements: Open tabs in the same browser after downloading, or connect separate devices through PeerJS with internet access. Keep the teacher tab open.

games.title: Grammar Battleship
games.description: Answer grammar questions to find and sink the opposing fleet.
games.offlineReason: Same-browser rooms work offline after download. Separate devices need internet.
games.instructions: Create a room and share its code with one opponent. Each player places five ships. Choose a target cell and speak a sentence using its subject and participle. Your opponent judges the grammar. A correct sentence can hit a ship. A grammar failure costs your turn and leaves that cell available for another attempt. Sink all 17 opponent segments to win. Confirm locks a placed fleet; controls 1 and 2 judge a pending attack.
games.requirements: Two tabs in one browser can play offline after download. Separate devices use public PeerJS signalling and both need internet. Keep the host open. Use touch or keyboard to select board cells.

games.title: The Grammar Time Machine
games.description: Travel through stories and discover how English tenses work.
games.requirements: One screen. Explore seven authored chapters, match the grammar pairs and use numbered controls for the quizzes.

games.title: Human Sentence Scramble
games.description: Turn your classroom into a living sentence-building challenge.
games.requirements: One screen and physical word tags. Use the 48 classroom prompts or load a sentence pack to show shuffled words. The teacher judges the sentence and awards points.

games.title: Memory Court
games.description: Read one library case, then recall its evidence in a 15-question round.
games.offlineReason: The passage and all questions run offline after download.
games.instructions: Start the five-minute reading window, or finish reading early. Start the questions with the passage hidden. Team mode requires a buzz before every attempt. Use 1–4 to answer and Next to advance after a correct answer.
games.requirements: Touch or keyboard. Team mode also accepts a mapped button for Buzz. The teacher decides which team has the floor.

games.title: Mega Console
games.description: Unlock the console by solving vocabulary and spelling clues.
games.offlineReason: The download includes the game, built-in questions and controls.

games.title: Mission: 30-Stage Override
games.description: Complete a sequence of vocabulary and trivia security challenges.
games.offlineReason: Static browser game; all runtime assets hosted locally.
games.instructions: Read each clue and type its access word. A correct answer unlocks the next stage. There is no time limit or elimination: keep trying until the mission is complete. Progress resumes in this browser. Use the first-letter hint if needed, or bring your own vocabulary pack.
games.requirements: One screen or device. Keyboard, touch keyboard, or a mapped gamepad confirm button. No server or account required.

games.title: Operation: Chronos
games.description: Complete a four-phase mission with prepositions, past-perfect timelines, science questions and sentence corrections.
games.requirements: One screen. Read and type sentences, choose numbered answers and use Confirm to continue. Fixed authored mission with a 30-minute timer. No server or account required.

games.title: The Paradox at Blackwood Manor
games.description: Trace a route, compare suspect timelines and write evidence reports to solve an authored mystery.
games.requirements: One screen. Fixed murder-mystery story with open writing tasks and three grammar questions. A teacher reviews the reports after basic structure checks. Use numbered choices, Confirm, Next and Hint for the evidence file.

games.title: Sentence Auction
games.description: Compete in an auction where correct sentences win the round.
games.offlineReason: Download for dealer play and two tabs in the same browser. Separate devices need internet.
games.instructions: Open a room as dealer. Ask learners to bid on a sentence, judge its grammar and explain their choice. Record one verdict per sentence. A bidder can enter a bid from a second screen with the same room code. Dealer controls 1, 2 and 3 record correct, explained and incorrect verdicts. Next advances a lot. The bidder uses Confirm to submit.
games.requirements: One browser works offline after download. Choose Same browser in both tabs. For separate devices, select Separate devices on both and keep the dealer connected.

games.title: Sentence Showdown
games.description: Buzz in to transcribe spoken sentences or read pronunciation challenges aloud for classroom points.
games.offlineReason: Same-browser rooms work offline after download. Separate devices need internet.
games.instructions: The teacher creates a room and shares its link with two players. The teacher picks listening or speaking, both players wager points, then the teacher releases the buzzer. Dictate the prompt in listening rounds or judge pronunciation in speaking rounds. Players can request a steal in speaking rounds. The first player to reach 100,000 points or outlast the other balance wins.
games.requirements: Use three tabs in the same browser after downloading, or connect the teacher and both players through PeerJS with internet access. Keep the teacher tab open.

games.title: Spelling Bee
games.description: Spin, spell, and celebrate a classroom spelling champion.
games.requirements: One computer with an optional extended projector display. Open the display tab in the same browser; it does not connect separate devices. Nicknames and vocabulary stay in this browser.

games.title: Sudden Death Spelling Bee
games.description: Keep your place in a high-energy spelling elimination challenge.
games.requirements: One computer with an optional extended projector display. Open the display tab in the same browser; it does not connect separate devices. Nicknames and vocabulary stay in this browser.

games.title: Tense Master
games.description: Choose the right tense and survive the next grammar round.
games.offlineReason: All grammar questions and game files are included in the download.
games.instructions: Answer grammar challenges before each timer expires. Identify a tense, fill a verb, correct a sentence or complete a grammar rule. Three mistakes end the round. A custom quiz pack replaces the authored challenges with multiple-choice questions.
games.requirements: One screen. Touch, keyboard or mapped controller answers 1–8 and Confirm for typed answers. Works offline after download.

games.title: Time Zone Travelers
games.description: Take turns answering spoken English questions in a timed team challenge.
games.offlineReason: Includes the question bank, map and all game files.
games.instructions: Four teams take turns. Answer aloud, then the teacher reveals the answer and marks Correct or Wrong. The first attempt earns 5 points. Later attempts earn 1. A timeout passes the same question to the next team. Confirm reveals, 1 marks correct and 2 marks wrong.
games.requirements: One screen and a teacher to judge spoken answers. Supports your own word/clue packs. Works offline after download.

games.title: Transformation Taboo
games.description: Transform sentences against the clock, then describe a hidden word while avoiding forbidden clues.
games.offlineReason: Same-browser rooms work offline after download. Separate devices need internet.
games.instructions: Create a teacher room. On the student screen select the same connection mode and enter the room code. In the drill, reveal a sentence and transform it aloud within ten seconds. The teacher grades with buttons 1 and 2. In Taboo, describe each of 15 words for the teacher to guess. A gallery sentence pack adds a correction drill in the lobby.
games.requirements: Two tabs in the same browser, or two internet-connected devices with PeerJS signalling. Keep the teacher screen open.

games.title: Vocab Spelling Bet
games.description: Dictate and spell English vocabulary, wagering classroom points and reviewing missed words.
games.offlineReason: Same-browser rooms work offline after download. Separate devices need internet.
games.instructions: Open a teacher room and enter its code on the student screen. The student places a point wager, spells the dictated word aloud and the teacher types the response. Every third correct answer in a streak can unlock a double wager. Every 15th round is all-in. Teachers can choose a word pack in the lobby.
games.requirements: Use two tabs in the same browser after downloading, or connect two devices through PeerJS with internet access. Keep the teacher tab open.

games.title: Grammar Betting Game
games.description: Wager classroom points on English quiz questions. Correct teams earn their wagers and split the round’s lost points.
games.offlineReason: Same-browser team rooms work offline after download. Separate devices need internet.
games.instructions: Create a room and share its team link. Teams join before the game starts. Choose one answer and a wager before the timer runs out. Correct teams win their wager and share the round’s lost points. A teacher can choose a custom quiz pack in the lobby.
games.requirements: Use the teacher tab and at least one team tab in the same browser after downloading, or connect separate devices using PeerJS with internet access.

games.title: WH-Questions Game Show
games.description: Build confidence with who, what, where, when, why, and how.
games.offlineReason: The download includes the game, built-in questions and controls.

games.title: World History Quiz
games.description: Explore world history through an English quiz adventure.
games.offlineReason: The download includes the game, built-in questions and controls.

games.title: English World Cup
games.description: Answer English challenges and score in a penalty shootout.
games.offlineReason: The game and its stadium clips run offline after download.
games.instructions: Enter two nicknames. Answer together for goals or play a penalty minigame when only one player is correct. Reach a five-goal streak to win. An imported quiz can use two to four options per question.
games.requirements: Two local players. Use touch buttons, mapped controls, two gamepads, or A/S/D/F and J/K/L/semicolon. For movement use Q/E/W/Z and the arrow keys.

games.title: Restaurant Mission
games.description: Listen to 15 restaurant dialogues, switch between customer and server, then practise with the customer lines hidden.
games.instructions: Choose the CEFR track. Play the dialogue, repeat it in pairs, and switch roles. Hide the customer lines when you are ready for an extra challenge.

games.title: The Worst Restaurant in the World
games.description: Read a restaurant order, listen for the waiter’s mistake and earn points by correcting it politely. Play 12 rounds with a teacher and an optional projector.
games.instructions: Choose a CEFR deck, open the optional projector, and read each waiter reply aloud. Start the ten-second timer, select a team and award points or offer another team a steal.
games.requirements: A teacher reads the replies aloud. The optional projector opens in a second window on the same browser.

games.title: Family Sprint
games.description: Work through 54 family vocabulary and sentence challenges with hints, model answers and extension tasks. Add a word deck for your class.

games.title: Speaking Quest
games.description: Trade numbered paper tickets as you invite classmates, ask about their preferences and compare how many guests chose your event.
games.instructions: Give each learner three paper tickets marked with their nickname or a unique number. Model both roles, then time three invitation rounds and count the different guests.
games.requirements: Paper or reusable tickets for each learner. Learners speak in pairs during the group rounds.

games.title: Numbers, Dates & Times
games.description: Learn, play, and pronounce numbers, dates, and times.
games.instructions: Choose A1, A2, or B1. Use Learn for examples, Play for spoken replies, and Sounds for pronunciation. Each block has a 15-minute timer and built-in audio.

games.title: The Party Invite
games.description: Mingle, invite your classmates, and arrange a party.
games.offlineReason: All seven slides and their timers run offline after download.
games.instructions: Practise an invitation with a partner, then circulate to invite three classmates, negotiate a different time and share a party plan. Next changes slides. Confirm starts or pauses the round timer.
games.requirements: Use a classroom display or a shared screen for at least four speakers. Use touch, keyboard or mapped buttons.

games.title: Daily Routines
games.description: Build everyday routines with useful verbs and questions.
games.instructions: Explore routine verbs and time expressions. Listen to the recordings, select answers, and use your chosen times to present a daily routine.
games.requirements: Use the built-in recordings for listening. Teacher quiz packs add a separate question section.

games.title: In a Clothing Store
games.description: Practise asking about clothes, prices, sizes, and colours.
games.instructions: Choose the CEFR level and move through its twelve slides. Open the role-play cards to practise shopping dialogue and switch between customer and clerk.

games.title: Clothing Vocabulary Lab
games.description: Explore and practise the words you need in a clothing store.
games.instructions: Find a word to add it to the glossary, try a quick challenge, or create a shop sketch based on numbered participants.
games.requirements: The projection view syncs in the same browser. An installed English voice can read the example sentences. The text is always available.

games.title: Mystery Menu: Master Chef
games.description: Shop for ingredients, negotiate a budget and present a three-course menu in English.
games.offlineReason: Market, checkout, teaching panel and judging run offline in the same browser.
games.instructions: Choose team competition or cashier-only mode. Scan an ingredient code or search by name. Teams prepare and present three courses in English. The teacher can judge the menus directly or import a verdict JSON.
games.requirements: Use tabs within the same browser for checkout, consultation and projection. Barcode scanners can type a code and Enter. Manual product search is available.

games.title: The Missing Key
games.description: Solve eight English riddles and follow the evidence to enter a secret code. Four mystery cases with printable clues and classroom projection.
games.instructions: Choose a case and open its clues on another screen or print them. Solve eight riddles, extract and order the letters, and enter the team number followed by the code. The School Route unlocks an optional bonus case for each team.
games.requirements: The projector syncs with the game in the same browser. The clues also open in a print-friendly browser view.

games.title: S & Z Pronunciation Lab
games.description: Hear and practise /s/ and /z/ with American English audio and a 14-word listening challenge.
games.instructions: Listen to the example words and sentences. In solo mode, choose the word you hear for each prompt. In class mode, ask students to show a number and reveal the answer.
games.requirements: Sound is required for the listening rounds. Built-in recordings are included in the download.

games.title: Beer, Bird, Bear, Beard
games.description: Practise American English vowel contrasts with short recordings and a six-word listening challenge.
games.instructions: Listen to the example words and sentences. In solo mode, choose the word you hear for each prompt. In class mode, ask students to show a number and reveal the answer.
games.requirements: Sound is required for the listening rounds. Built-in recordings are included in the download.

games.title: Guess the Patient
games.description: Describe symptoms and discover the mystery patient.
games.instructions: Pick a board. In pairs, one player secretly chooses an illustrated patient while the other asks yes/no questions and crosses out cards. In solo mode, the game answers your questions.
games.requirements: Each board includes picture descriptions for text-based play.

games.title: Health Lotería
games.description: Play a visual lotería game with health and symptom vocabulary.
games.instructions: Call cards as words or riddles. In class, open a numbered board in another tab or print it. In solo mode, draw and mark your own cards. Complete a row, column or diagonal and claim Lotería.
games.requirements: Digital class boards sync in the same browser. Built-in recordings play offline. Read custom clues aloud or use an installed English voice.

games.title: Clinic Rally
games.description: Race through five courses with English vocabulary, matching and sentence challenges. Play solo or share a room with teams.

games.title: The Dental Lab
games.description: Explore dental vocabulary through interactive practice.
games.instructions: Explore the illustrated vocabulary, compare words in context, then reveal the answers in a practice round. Select a CEFR level for the role-play and drawing activities.
games.requirements: The 3D model uses WebGL. Local illustrations are available for reduced-motion settings and browsers without WebGL.

games.title: Monster Smiles
games.description: Help the monsters keep their teeth in a classroom challenge.
games.instructions: Choose one to six teams. Take turns answering a timed prompt. Correct answers earn coins and incorrect answers cost a tooth. Three coins restore a missing tooth.
games.requirements: For classroom play, a teacher judges answers and can open the projector view in a second tab. A solo imported quiz scores each selection automatically.

games.title: Classroom Survey Show
games.description: Two teams race to name the most popular survey answers. Win the face-off, run the board and try to steal after three strikes.
games.instructions: Open a question, then buzz for Team A or Team B. Type the spoken answer or select it from the teacher list. Review the board after each round and open the next survey.
games.requirements: The projector opens in the same browser. Touch, keyboard and gamepad use the common controls. An Arduino and installed on-device English dictation are optional.

games.title: Farito: Conversation Missions
games.description: Review family vocabulary, write six replies in a guided conversation, and create a portrait of an imaginary family.
games.instructions: Start a solo mission or join a classroom room. Review family words, say and write your replies, then choose the cast and setting for an illustrated portrait.
games.requirements: Solo missions and same-browser classrooms work offline. Rooms across devices use internet signalling. Teacher dashboards show progress and help requests.

games.title: Grammar Rush
games.description: Race, bet points, and explain your grammar choices.
games.requirements: Projector mode works on one computer after download. Separate player devices require internet for room signalling. The standalone HTML download includes the built-in cards. Gallery downloads also support your saved sentence pack.
